blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — The city government of Victorias in Negros Occidental has distributed PSR 03-171, a high-yielding and pest-tolerant sugarcane variety, to 50 agrarian reform beneficiaries (ARBs) in Barangay V to help farmers cope with the destructive Red-Striped Soft Scale Insect (RSSI). The high-quality cane points were turned over to the farmers on Thursday, Sept. 17, for field cultivation. Philippine Sugar Research Institute (PHILSURIN) Director General Maria Regina Martin said Victorias City is the first local government to fund small sugarcane farmers, aiming to improve productivity and strengthen their crops against pests.
